facts.fact: The article says Côte d'Ivoire presented (unveiled) a comprehensive national digital development roadmap at the Africa Investment Forum in Rabat on 26 November 2025, delivered by Kalil Ibrahim Konaté, with a target of 6-8% of GDP from the digital sector by 2028 and 12-15% later; it names no adopting act or body.
facts.system: Digital transformation roadmap presented at the Africa Investment Forum 2025

facts.fact: The article calls the National Rural Connectivity Programme a major component of the strategy, allocating more than CFA 28 billion for 2024-2025 and a further CFA 33 billion for 2026-2027.
